name: subscription-usage
title: Subscription usage
description: Subscription usage: a page on the rail with how much of your Claude, ChatGPT (Codex), OpenCode Go, Grok, Z.ai, and MiniMax plans is used, and when each limit resets, plus the DeepSeek balance, a status line item with the quota of the open session's model provider, and a /usage-plans command that posts the same usage as a card in chat. The server asks each service with the sign-ins already on this machine, and sends each key only to its own service (anthropic.com, opencode.ai, grok.com, z.ai, minimax.io, deepseek.com). No key or token reaches the browser.
